title: Dolisie municipal employees’ work stoppage over accumulated salary arrears
possible_unit_owner: Possibly 2021-07; confirm whether Dolisie shared the July 9 onset reported for several municipalities or began later. The January report is a continuation observation, not a new onset.
notes: Le Courrier de Kinshasa reported Dolisie among municipalities striking from July 9, 2021; SACER reported the municipal offices and morgue locked in December and again in January, when the strike was described as lasting several months. On Jan. 16 the union representative said minimum service would begin the following week after a protocol and a worker assembly; actual resumption is not confirmed. The reports give no turnout and do not establish a public gathering. Keep as a cross-month continuation lead, not a January-onset event.
